# BYZ scope, monthly. Counts the months of surplus without debt; settles the merits in the first month of a quarter.
oe_m5_monthly = {
    if = {
        limit = { oe_m5_bal > 0 oe_m5_debt <= 0 }
        if = { limit = { NOT = { has_variable = oe_m5_surplus_m } } set_variable = { name = oe_m5_surplus_m value = 0 } }
        change_variable = { name = oe_m5_surplus_m add = 1 }
    }
    else_if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_m5_surplus_m } remove_variable = oe_m5_surplus_m }
    if = { limit = { oe_m5_quarter = yes } oe_m5_settle = yes }
}
